candidates.name: Chromoblastomycosis
support_spans: Infiltrate of foamy histiocytes and pigmented yeasts without multiaxial septation (Fontana-Masson)
pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia, parakeratosis, dense dermal infiltrate of histiocytes, foamy histiocytes, neutrophils, and multinucleate giant cells along with pigmented hyphae
Fungal skin culture: black yeastlike colonies characteristic of Exophiala spinifera species
candidates.why: The patient's skin lesions and histopathology results are consistent with Chromoblastomycosis, a fungal infection caused by Exophiala spinifera species.

candidates.name: Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis
support_spans: involvement of the upper respiratory tract, causing palatal perforation and stridor, necessitating a tracheostomy a year ago
saddle nose deformity, perforation of the hard palate
contradict_spans: Serologic analysis for HIV-1/2, antinuclear antibody, and antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies: negative
candidates.why: The patient's respiratory symptoms and nasal deformity are consistent with Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis, but the negative serologic tests contradict this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Leprosy

nerotic plaques on the ear with destruction of ear cartilage
candidates.why: The patient's skin lesions and destruction of ear cartilage are consistent with Leprosy, a chronic infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium leprae.
